column2: Resident Households by Household Living Arrangement and Selected Characteristics

column4: 1/ Total includes other types of dwellings not shown, e.g. non-HDB shophouses.
3/ Based on ranking of all resident households by their monthly household income from all sources per household member (including employer CPF contributions).

4/ It is notable that some resident households in the lowest 20% income group owned a car (13.5%), employed a domestic helper (14.7%), lived in private property (6.7%) or were with household reference persons aged 65 years and over (35.5%) in 2017/18.
